title: Odd Dirac-shell plateau
assumptions: Intrinsic massless Dirac operator on a sphere, fixed area, completely occupied positive shells and odd degree at least three.
Quadratic energy response at a fixed finite shell count.
obligation: Derive the native coupling and physical readout and check nonlinear and dynamical stability. H96 remains open.

title: Bifocal radial probe shape
excerpt: Strikte Konvexität auf [a−|w|,a+|w|] schließt die Bedingung für jedes w≠0 aus, weil S_K am großen Scheitel strikt größer als an der kleinen Achse ist.
assumptions: Common Euclidean chart, two equally normalized radial probe signals, fixed major vertex and nonzero focus separation.
obligation: Derive distinguishable calibrated channels and a physical boundary equation from the native action. H96 remains open.

title: Mediator candidate profile
excerpt: Alle drei setzen η oder die Grundzahlen voraus, statt sie zu liefern (A1).
assumptions: Exploratory comparison restricted to I1, I4 and k185 against the documented A1–A5 profile.
obligation: Derive a stable intermediary with independent scale and sector maps. The candidate comparison leaves OP1–OP5, C5 and C6/T2 open.

title: Unitary boosts and the area quantum
excerpt: Nein, ein unitär wirkender Boost ändert das Flächenspektrum nicht (Rovelli–Speziale).
assumptions: Literature reading of Rovelli and Speziale, gr-qc/0205108; the boost generator is assumed to act unitarily.
obligation: Derive a non-unitary frame map or a mean-value reading of the T parameter. OP1 remains open.

title: Rule of frame T and the dimension ladder
excerpt: Die Leiter T, M, P gilt genau für γ₀ ∈ [1; 1,0757) · γ_T.
assumptions: Moran reading of the counting equation (r29.3) and the nine counting rules of r09.
obligation: Justify a unit in the window without reference to T, or another data-free reason for j = 1/2 only. OP1 remains open.

title: Chance estimate of the hits of gamma_L
excerpt: Nach der vorab festgelegten Lesart (36 · P über 0,3) ist das **mit Zufall verträglich**.
assumptions: Procedure fixed in commit 8557ed7: 16 targets, 8 forms, 2 sigma window, 36 counting-rule pairs.
obligation: Fix the pair DL/ABCK without reference to the data; otherwise the hits carry no evidential weight.

title: One number and five translations
excerpt: Die **Zahlenwerte** von OP2 bis OP5 lassen sich alle auf die eine Zahl aus OP1 zurückführen
assumptions: Assumption list of r08 and the notes cited in the root map; no computation.
obligation: Derive the five translations from one coupling. OP1–OP5, C5 and C6/T2 remain open.

title: Direct compensator on closed odd states
assumptions: Closed generation states with embedding S satisfying JS = -S, as in generation-coupling.tex.
guard: Native phase direction on the null line
obligation: Derive an embedding or coupling that fixes the real direction of the octant null line from J.

title: Two windows and the orientation of the octant step
excerpt: Unter allen 16 Maskenkombinationen gibt es dreimal \(+45^\circ\), dreimal \(-45^\circ\), neun Sperren und einen mehrdeutigen Fall.
assumptions: Binary admissibility masks in two windows; the first window is read as one provisional state.
guard: Native selection of the ordered return
obligation: Identify the quantity that decides the sign in the second window. OP3 remains open.

title: Lambda as an input within the record
excerpt: Das „warum heute“ ist dieselbe Eingabe wie der Wert von Λ, keine zweite.
assumptions: The named class of constructions of layer r56 (frame maps and readouts, W1/W2 under G1 and G2, semiclassical route, comparison model, cascade).
obligation: A construction with its own length or a dimensionless number near 1e-122 would escape the result. OP5 remains open.

title: Cascade attractor Omega_M = beta^2 against DESI DR2
excerpt: # Ergebnis H124: Kaskade mit Attraktor Ω_M = β² (ε = 3) an DESI DR2 BAO nicht ausgeschlossen, aber mit Ω_M heute ≈ 0,50 und Δχ² = 7,9 gegen ΛCDM
assumptions: Feedback cascade with bridge 3 of r05.5; epsilon = 3 is chosen so that the attractor equals beta^2; only BAO data.
guard: Why the ratio is seen today
obligation: Explain the epoch; CMB, supernovae and growth not checked. OP5 and H96 remain open.

title: Temporally ordered octant readout on a puncture
excerpt: | H123d | γ_M′ = 0,2341229, γ_L′ = 1,837930, β′ = 0,543379, m_W′ = 80,0994 GeV (−20,3σ), Ω_M′ = 0,2953 (−0,26σ) | alle drei Fenster | trägt nicht (β und m_W verfehlt) |
assumptions: Setting S123: three windows R, T, J_B in temporal order; the origin of the time direction tau is not derived.
guard: Native readout supplying weight two at every spin
obligation: Find a readout that separates both orientations of a puncture for every j. Q1a, OP1 and OP3 remain open.

title: Relative CP sign of leptons and quarks
excerpt: Vorhersage unter S1: sign(J_PMNS) = −sign(J_CKM), also sin δ_PMNS < 0.
assumptions: Setting S1: CP violation arises in the same way from the family structure in both sectors; CT-003 and the Lorentz reading of r33.2.
guard: Derivation of the CP bridge S1
obligation: Derive S1 from an action; the sign is decided by a determination at 3 sigma (deadline 2035). OP3 and OP4 remain open.

title: Derivations of the Albert-type algebra over the sedenions
excerpt: | H128a: dim Der(H₃(𝕊)) | **22** (Lücke 1,5·10¹³); Anteil außerhalb von g₂ ⊕ so(3): 0,16 | = 17 | **widerlegt** |
assumptions: H_3(S) is a construction on three copies, not a step of the tower; the three places are read as generations (setting).
The mass form K is a canonical but chosen quadratic form; its sign in a potential is not fixed.
guard: Sign of the mass form from the field equation
obligation: Derive the sign of K and the identification of places with generations from the field equation; dimension 22 is numerical (singular-value gap), an exact rank is missing. OP3 remains open.

title: Charge direction orthogonal to the doubling unit
excerpt: # Ergebnis H130: Die Ladungsrichtung liegt senkrecht zur Verdopplungseinheit, das Verhältnis 9/10 ist festgelegt
assumptions: The carrier is a colour-stable octonion subalgebra of the sedenions on which su(3)_c acts as 1 + 1 + 3 + 3bar.
guard: Why the carrier is an octonion subalgebra
obligation: Derive the requirement of an alternative, colour-stable carrier from the tower or the field equation. OP3 remains open.

title: S4 with the charge as generalised CP: one class, TM2 without CP violation
excerpt: # Ergebnis H131: Eine einzige Klasse, aber mit δ = 0 oder 180°: TM2 ohne CP-Verletzung, θ₂₃ nicht maximal
assumptions: Copy k sits on place k of H_3(S); Z3 for charged leptons, Z2 with CP for Majorana neutrinos on the complex triplet (settings).
guard: Carrier and residual symmetries of the neutrino sector
obligation: Derive the carrier (complex triplet or real part, k262) and the residual symmetries; the reading stands poorly against data. OP3 and OP4 remain open.

title: The carrier of the neutrinos decides between TM2 and TM1
excerpt: # Welche Setzung aus H131 trägt die Spannung? (Erkundung k262, nicht blind, 25.11.2026)
assumptions: Majorana neutrinos on the real part of the entries, with a real mass form; Z3 for charged leptons and one odd Z2 (settings).
Exploration, not blind.
obligation: Decide from the mass form or the field equation whether the neutral field lives on the real part; the choice of the odd Z2 and the sign of sin delta remain open. OP3 and OP4 remain open.

title: Frame correction makes the TM1 class compatible with JUNO, without a prediction
excerpt: # Ergebnis H134: Mit der Frame-Korrektur ist die TM1-Klasse mit JUNO verträglich, aber ohne Vorhersage
assumptions: Frame map for mixing: mask D = exp(eps W_l) with eps = artanh(beta_sym) (r57, H45), a reading without derivation from an action; beta_sym is inserted (OP1).
Partly not blind: the data were known; the rotation phi is free.
guard: Rotation angle and frame map of the mixing
obligation: Fix the free rotation phi from the algebra and derive the mask from an action; only then does a prediction for theta23 and delta follow. OP3 and OP4 remain open.
